_comment: Per-(method/dataset/error_class) minimum recall floors for the coverage regression gate. Floors are seeded from a verified full-RAHA `dataforge bench --quick` run and lock in current coverage so it cannot silently regress. Detection floors (@detection) credit flagging the error; plain keys credit exact correction. WINNABLE-HALF OPPORTUNITY (measured 2026-07-07): flights text_normalization detection = 0.00 over n=1729 real errors - the single largest undetected slice; adding a detection-only (tier-1, strictly additive) detector for it is the top coverage lever and must not regress hospital 0.7926. Enforced by dataforge.bench.check_coverage_regression.
